selected_evidence.requirement: Readable by inventory-readers group, inaccessible to other users
selected_evidence.summary: sudo -u nobody read attempt denied (exit 1); sudo -u inventorysvc succeeded; temporary group-member testreader successfully read records.csv, confirming group readability while non-members are blocked

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: reboot acknowledgement and changed boot identity
